name: autosave-notify
description: Shows pop-up notifications for the autosave.sh backups (success, unbacked-up changes, push failure).

autosaveNotify.showSuccess.description: Show a notification every time a backup succeeds.

autosaveNotify.showPending.description: Warn when changes stay unbacked up for too long.

autosaveNotify.showFailure.description: Show an error when a backup push fails.
